worldcombat.skill.waterfall.summary: Water wells up into a vertical curtain behind the user, who crouches and pounces bodily: on contact the curtain slams the target, shoving it back and maybe flinching it; in the rain the water is stronger.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.0: Shove or pin one target at close range
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.1: Flinch a target to open a damage window for allies
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.2: Pounce in the rain for a stronger surge
Advances %2$s blocks along the pounce at %3$s per tick with a %4$s block radius; the hit deals %1$s contact damage.
On a hit the target is shoved %1$s blocks and has a %2$s chance to flinch for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.torrent.on: Torrent form: pounces farther and heavier and flinches longer, but moves slower and takes a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.torrent.off: Rapid form: shorter, faster pounces with a smoother cycle, at the cost of a lighter blow and a shorter flinch.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.growth.0: From level %1$s the crash power rises to %2$s and the pounce to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.growth.1: From level %1$s the crash power rises to %2$s, the pounce to %3$s blocks, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.preference.t: On: a thicker curtain, pounce distance x1.1, power x1.08, flinch chance x1.15 and a longer flinch, but pounce speed x0.92 and +2 wind-up / +7 cooldown. Off (rapid): shorter, faster pounces with a smoother cycle, at the cost of a lighter blow and a shorter flinch.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: targets already carrying the shared flinch identity rank lower, saving the pounce for a foe that can still act; off: all targets score the same.
